name: invisible sign -Isu- Nemureru Mori
original_name: invisible sign -イス- 眠れる森
source:
It is still a story about the mystery of unsolved incident happened 20 years ago having something to do with present suspicious events, but the main difference is in the big number of different endings. There are also new capturable characters with their stories individual resolutions and the possibility to see the true end with the eyes of another protagonist.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
故事依然围绕20年前的一起未解事件展开，那起事件与当下发生的可疑现象有所关联。不过，本作最大的不同在于拥有大量不同结局。游戏还增加了新的可攻略角色，各自拥有独立的故事结局；玩家也可以从另一名主人公的视角见证真结局。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
